checkConstraints.name: league_draft_order_meta_stamps_check
checkConstraints.definition: CHECK ((((state = 'open'::text) AND (finalized_at IS NULL) AND (locked_at IS NULL)) OR ((state = 'finalized'::text) AND (finalized_at IS NOT NULL) AND (locked_at IS NULL)) OR ((state = 'locked'::text) AND (finalized_at IS NOT NULL) AND (locked_at IS NOT NULL))))

checkConstraints.name: league_draft_slots_check
checkConstraints.definition: CHECK (((price_min IS NULL) OR (price_max IS NULL) OR (price_min <= price_max)))

policies.name: league_members_insert_self
policies.withCheck:
((user_id = (auth.uid())::text) AND (role = 'commissioner'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM leagues l
  WHERE ((l.id = league_members.league_id) AND (l.commissioner_id = (auth.uid())::text) AND (l.draft_status = 'not_started'::text)))) AND (hidden_at IS NULL) AND (deleted_at IS NULL))

checkConstraints.name: league_renewal_responses_stamps_check
checkConstraints.definition: CHECK ((((status = 'pending'::text) AND (decided_by IS NULL) AND (responded_at IS NULL)) OR ((status <> 'pending'::text) AND (decided_by IS NOT NULL) AND (responded_at IS NOT NULL))))

checkConstraints.name: league_roster_reconfirm_stamps_check
checkConstraints.definition: CHECK ((((choice = 'pending'::text) AND (chosen_by IS NULL) AND (chosen_at IS NULL)) OR ((choice = 'invite'::text) AND (chosen_by IS NOT NULL) AND (chosen_at IS NOT NULL))))

policies.name: Users can view league seasons for their leagues
policies.using:
(league_id IN ( SELECT league_members.league_id
   FROM league_members
  WHERE (league_members.user_id = (auth.uid())::text)))

checkConstraints.name: leagues_matchup_requires_playoff_teams
checkConstraints.definition: CHECK (((league_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'matchup'::text) OR (playoff_teams IS NOT NULL)))

checkConstraints.name: leagues_pick_clock_started_check
checkConstraints.definition: CHECK (((NOT pick_clock_enabled) OR (draft_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'in_progress'::text) OR (draft_started_at IS NOT NULL)))

checkConstraints.name: matchups_playoff_address
checkConstraints.definition: CHECK (((COALESCE(is_playoff, false) AND (playoff_round_number IS NOT NULL) AND (bracket_position IS NOT NULL) AND (playoff_round_number >= 1) AND (bracket_position >= 0)) OR ((NOT COALESCE(is_playoff, false)) AND (playoff_round_number IS NULL) AND (bracket_position IS NULL))))

policies.name: Users can view trades in their leagues
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM league_members
  WHERE ((league_members.league_id = trades.league_id) AND (league_members.user_id = (auth.uid())::text))))

cronJobs.command:
select net.http_post(
    url     := 'https://haiaaifjcclsvmkfqgmd.supabase.co/functions/v1/draft-autopick-sweep',
    headers := jsonb_build_object(
      'Content-Type', 'application/json',
      'apikey', (select decrypted_secret from vault.decrypted_secrets where name = 'cron_apikey' limit 1)
    ),
    body    := '{}'::jsonb,
    timeout_milliseconds := 180000
  )
  where exists (
    select 1
      from public.overdue_draft_turns() o
     where not exists (
       select 1
         from public.draft_stalls s
        where s.league_id = o.league_id
          and s.pick_number = o.pick_number
          and s.reason <> 'vendor_outage'
          and s.last_seen_at > now() - interval '60 seconds'
     )
       and not exists (
       select 1
         from public.draft_turn_outages t
        where t.league_id = o.league_id
          and t.pick_number = o.pick_number
          and t.last_seen_at > now() - interval '10 seconds'
     )
  )
     or public.draft_auto_start_work_due();
delete from cron.job_run_details where coalesce(end_time, start_time) < now() - interval '7 days'
delete from public.rate_limit_counters where window_start < now() - interval '2 days'

SELECT net.http_post(
    url := 'https://haiaaifjcclsvmkfqgmd.supabase.co/functions/v1/snapshot-week-end',
    headers := jsonb_build_object(
      'Content-Type', 'application/json',
      -- Attempt 3 = the function's MAX_RETRIES: an incomplete heal fails loudly
      -- instead of scheduling 'snapshot-week-end-retry-2', which would replace a
      -- pending Friday retry of the same name (pg_cron replaces by name).
      'X-Retry-Attempt', '3',
      'apikey', (SELECT decrypted_secret FROM vault.decrypted_secrets WHERE name = 'cron_apikey' LIMIT 1)
    ),
    body := '{}'::jsonb,
    -- pg_net's 5 s default is shorter than a run; the outcome is read from the data
    -- the job writes, not from net._http_response (CLAUDE.md success-signal #8).
    timeout_milliseconds := 180000
  );
